headlines.text: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO just 11 days after his ouster, adding nearly $1 trillion in market value as shares jump over 30%
SEC, congressional, and California AG probes into Nvidia's disclosures and Huang's China ties continue despite his reinstatement
Wall Street warms back up to Nvidia as Bernstein, Oppenheimer and StoneX upgrade the stock on Huang's return, lifting chip names into the Black Friday close
Strategists warn looming Fed rate hikes, not AI jitters, are the bigger threat to stocks as traders now price a December quarter-point hike as a near lock
Houthi strike kills a worker and forces a partial shutdown at Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, deepening oil's war-risk premium ahead of OPEC+'s Nov. 29 meeting on 2027 output
Criminal probe into Nvidia supplier Megaspeed over alleged China chip-smuggling remains active amid the broader Huang fallout
